title: Fennel-White Bean Soup with Mixed Vegetables, Basil Pesto & Parmesan

ingredients.name: Frozen Mixed Vegetables (carrots (corn, green beans, peas))

steps.text: Wash and dry fennel; trim off root end and dark green stalks, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add fennel and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
When the fennel has softened, add beans, broth, frozen veggies, and pesto to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook until veggies are tender, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls, top with cheese, and drizzle with additional pesto. Enjoy!
